title: The Heaven Between Signals
timeline_origin: First PCM sample of the mastered WAV; MP3 uses encoder delay/padding metadata. No musical entrance offset is added.

cues.text: The room returns, but now the roof is open.
The stone is small beneath the travelled sky.
You brought a choir that cannot fit a mirror.
You brought a world that does not need to fly.
Listen here, the dark is full of makers.
Listen here, the little rooms are bright.
I was a name that someone left unfinished.
I am the care I give that name tonight.
You will not keep the whole of what has happened.
You can still leave a door within the song.
The alien is closer than the ceiling.
The human breath is carried all along.
Take up the tune and bend it into weather.
Make of this ending somewhere to begin.
I leave a stone. You leave another answer.
The heaven is the space we leave between.
Between the signals, let the garden listen.
Between the names, let other voices through.
There is no last reply to close the music.
There is a little light I leave for you.
Listen here.
I am listening.
